name: Data Link Financial Operating System
_comment_palette: dataColors are CATEGORICAL - series identity only. Assigned in fixed order, never cycled. A ninth series is never a generated hue: fold it into Other, facet into small multiples, or use composite encoding. Validated: worst adjacent CVD dE 9.1 (protan), worst adjacent normal-vision dE 19.6, all eight inside the lightness band and above the chroma floor, on the #fcfcfb surface.
_comment_relief: Slots 3, 4 and 5 (#1baf7a 2.74, #eda100 2.11, #e87ba4 2.62) sit below 3:1 against the light surface. That is not dismissable - any visual using them ships VISIBLE DATA LABELS or a table view alongside. See powerbi/report-spec.md.
_comment_series_cap: Scatter, bubble and small-multiple visuals compare ALL pairs rather than adjacent ones, and the full eight cannot clear the floors that way. Those forms cap at the FIRST THREE slots, which validate all-pairs. Slot 4 puts yellow next to orange, and that pair fails.
_comment_status: Status colors are RESERVED. They are never reused as a series color, and they never carry meaning alone - every status indicator in this report ships with an icon or a text label beside it. The measure `Project Risk Label` in measures.dax exists for exactly this: red and green are separated by only dE 7.1 under deuteranopia, below the dE 8 legibility floor, so colour alone is not readable for a meaningful share of people. This report goes to a CEO and a Controller, not a colour-vision panel.
_comment_diverging: Diverging scales (cost variance, fade/gain) use two hues with a NEUTRAL GRAY midpoint - never a hue at the middle, never a rainbow. Negative variance is the warm pole because over-running cost is the condition that needs attention.
_comment_dark: Power BI report themes are single-mode. The validated dark steps for the same eight hues on a #1a1a19 surface are: #3987e5, #d95926, #199e70, #c98500, #d55181, #008300, #9085e9, #e66767. Ship them as a second theme file if a dark variant is requested; do not machine-flip this one.

*._comment: Grid and axes are RECESSIVE. The data is the figure; the chrome is the ground.

labels._comment: On by default because three categorical slots fall below 3:1 on this surface and the relief rule requires visible labels. Turn them off only on a visual that already ships a table view.

legend._comment: A legend is always present for two or more series - identity is never carried by colour alone.

labels._comment: Never a number on every point. Direct-label the last point or the extremes only.
